senses.gloss: f. (preced.) a pair of tongs (cmp. זוּג).
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:6">Ab. V, 6</cite> (among the things created in the last moment before the Sabbath) <he>אף צ׳ בצ׳ עשויה</he> also tongs which (by human hands) can be made only by means of tongs; <cite ref="Pesachim 54a:7">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אף הצ׳</he> also the (first) tongs; v. next w.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2">Snh. VII, 2</cite> <he>פותחין את פיו בצ׳ וכ׳</he> they force his mouth open with tongs; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 2:3">Tosef. Sot. II, 3</cite> (v. <cite ref="K00683"><he>כַּלְבּוּס</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:15">Erub. X, 15</cite> <he>צ׳ של עץ</he> wooden tongs; a. e.
